title: Pivots, anchors, sockets, and hosts
plainLanguage: A reusable part needs to know what it connects to, where it rotates, and which host view it was designed for.
purpose: Turn a library of pose examples into parts that can eventually be attached and adjusted reliably.

rules.statement: Each poser part must name its anatomical root joint and its artwork pivot/anchor separately.
Use semantic host sockets such as ACTIVE_TORSO/ACTIVE_PELVIS so view-specific artwork can change without rewriting the anatomical role.
Socket mappings must be tested for each supported view family before being treated as production-compatible.
Preserve local pivot and anchor coordinates when mirroring only if the specific part has an approved mirror rule.

implementation.currentSupport: The canonical doll rig already has pivots, anchors and semantic sockets.
implementation.futureWork: Formalize Corpus Pane-to-doll mappings and test them with real extracted/approved parts.
